notes: Security (macOS): `launchpad secret set` no longer puts the credential on the `security` command line, where any user on the Mac could read it with `ps` while it ran. Values now go to `security -i` on stdin and are read back to confirm they were stored.

Static sites built with Jekyll, Hugo, Eleventy, MkDocs or Zola are now built on the runner and their output deployed. 0.1.1 deployed the source folder, so a Jekyll page went live showing raw `{{ site.title }}` tags. Run `launchpad apply` to regenerate the site workflow.
A surface with no branch set now uses the repository's own default branch (`master`, `develop`, …), not `main`. `setup` and `apply` tell you which branch they picked and why.

Expo: the iOS fastlane lane now lives next to `app.json`, not inside the `ios/` folder that `expo prebuild --clean` deletes on every run. `apply` names any old Fastfile left in `ios/`; delete that file yourself.
macOS: when no prebuild step is configured, `create-dmg.sh` no longer contains the line `undefined`, which stopped the release.
Flutter: dev/prod flavours are now a setting (`flavors: true|false`). An app that already has flavours of its own is left alone, and `apply` lists every native file before it changes any of them.
